text_block_list.text:
With that, Маяно Топ Ган has
successfully
made her debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She's been acting strange for a while...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Nothing's really the matter... It's
just that
it's over!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Is this it?! Is my debut really finished?
Just like
that?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You're not hiding anything from me, are
you?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She says that, but a debut match is
something
that can only be experienced
once.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem the slightest bit
satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Should we run in more races?

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I've finally debuted. I've come
all this
way.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It's something that's supposed to make
you
excited—make you twinkle.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
